paragraphs.text: Kasmina (sometimes shortened to " Mina ") is a former Planeswalker from Antausia , and a former Quandrix Junior Professor at Strixhaven University on Arcavios . She uses scry , transformation and control spells.

Kasmina is tall with a sinewy build. She has light skin, long reddish hair, and bright blue eyes. She usually wears a blue-white hooded cloak and carries a long shepherd's crook. She is always accompanied by a "parliament" of owls from several different planes.

Kasmina can use her transformation magic to polymorph organic beings. She can also take direct mental control of other people's actions, effectively possessing them. In addition, she can see through the eyes of her owl familiars over large distances. She can control air, being capable of creating blades out of pressurized air. In addition, she can create scrying portals between planes and watch other people's dreams. A special gift is that she can sense embers , unignited Planeswalkers.
Kasmina is centered in blue mana and secondary in green mana. When she used to planeswalk, a cloud of white feathers, much like the feathers of her owl familiars, whipped over her.

Kasmina used to be the leader of an ancient, secret order of Planeswalkers, a shadowy cabal with secret aims. The organization had been studying Planeswalker spark for centuries. Obsessed with recruiting new members, her preferred method was to identify embers , unignited Planeswalkers. She helped these mages to discover their potential, even if it meant causing trauma to ignite their spark, and then to indoctrinate them in the ways of her order. She revealed that she was preparing for a looming conflict that would dwarf the War of the Spark .
According to herself, she was entrusted with the legacy of all the Planeswalkers who came before her and with the preservation of the Multiverse.

Kasmina was lured to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon and immediately became trapped there due to Bolas 's use of the Immortal Sun . Alongside many other Planeswalkers and Ravnicans, she fought against the Eternals of Bolas' Dreadhorde . The skillful use of control magic allowed Kasmina to temporarily pull an Eternal to her side during the fight.

Kasmina went to Kylem and invited Rowan and Will Kenrith to study at Strixhaven . When the twins arrived at Arcavios , Kasmina guided them to the campus. Will asked Kasmina if she was a native of Arcavios. Kasmina replied that she had studied for many years on the plane , but was not native to it. Kasmina used one of her owls to watch the twins and discover their potential, while another of her owls watched over Lukka 's actions elsewhere on Arcavios.
She later confronted Lukka, who figured out she was spying on him. They battled, Kasmina winning but being forced to retreat once swarms of mage hunters arrived.

Kasmina had resided on Arcavios for quite some time, teaching introductory courses for Quandrix and for incoming students. But she didn't fully join the faculty until after the Invasion and losing her Planeswalker's spark in the Desparkening . Finding common ground, during this time she befriended Liliana Vess .

Despite the loss of her spark, she continued to recruit certain off-world students for Strixhaven University. For this, she exchanged Planeswalkers for promising wizards who could make the journey by Omenpath . She had identified her first five recruits ( Eula Blue , Alandra , Jamira , Kequia Akosa , and Segante Guarneri ) as embers ; potential planeswalkers. In consultation with Professor Vess , the five were chosen to be evenly distributed among the Colleges.

When the five young wizards started their courses, they began to notice that Kasmina's owls were following them everywhere. It was revealed that Kasmina had selected the five students because they had the potential to be powerful planeswalkers. Her underlying purpose was to force them to ignite under stressful circumstances, and to rob their sparks to reignite her own. This plot was thwarted by the students working together, and Kasmina presumably died in the final confrontation in the heart of a snarl . Aiming to imitate Nicol Bolas , the spell also would have destroyed the omenpaths and would have separated Arcavios in its original parts.

Kasmina was introduced in War of the Spark . Despite having a card in that set, she did not actually appear in the accompanying novel . However, her cards show her using magic against the Eternals on Ravnica, confirming that she was involved in the conflict. She was later given a brief cameo in one of the War of the Spark side stories on DailyMTG.com , where she was seen taking control of an Eternal and using it to fight against the rest of the Dreadhorde.

She was included in War of the Spark because she was going to appear in an upcoming set, and Wizards wanted to preview her. This set turned out to be Strixhaven: School of Mages , though originally it was to be Throne of Eldraine . She reappeared in the prequel novel Omens of Chaos for Secrets of Strixhaven , where she functioned as the main antagonist.
It is unclear what event Kasmina's cabal was preparing for, but it might have been the New Phyrexian Invasion . After her desparkening , Kasmina was no longer associated with the cabal.
